current.text: He is a rookie and a first-round pick of the Bulls.
His Summer League was called possibly the worst ever for a pick that high. In one game he scored 3 points in 28 minutes, shot 13% from the field and missed every three.

He is not in the projected Bulls rotation. The starters are Giddey, Powell, Buzelis, Caleb Wilson and Claxton. Tre Jones, Okoro, Jalen Smith and Hield come next, and Patrick Williams, Zach Collins or Leonard Miller is the 10th man.
Tiago Splitter is the new Bulls coach. He is expected to push young players out of their comfort zones.
The Bulls are expected to be a bottom team. One expert calls them bottom six, and another predicts 32 wins.
